verdict.rationale: Milvus runs as a programmatic, UI-less component. Milvus Lite is a Python library you start with a local file via `MilvusClient`, and Standalone runs in a Docker container, so scripted, headless automation is plausible. However, nothing in the evidence documents CI usage itself, so the depth of support for the CI part of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline documentation or examples (e.g., GitHub Actions or service containers), and hands-on corroboration of headless or CI runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: To create a local Milvus vector database, simply instantiate a `MilvusClient` by specifying a file name to store all data
With the same client-side code, you can run GenAI apps with Milvus Lite on a laptop or Jupyter Notebook, or Milvus Standalone on Docker container
Milvus Lite is a Python library that can be easily integrated into your applications.
Milvus also supports Standalone mode for single machine deployment.
